nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Calendula Deep Cleansing Foaming Face Wash

avis.titre: Been using this product for 3 years.
avis.texte: A little goes a long way for this powerhouse. One bottle lasts me around 5-6 months - only need half a pump, twice a day. I appreciate that it has minimal fragrance and a gentle foam. Before this cleanser i tried everything under the sun. Since i started using it, I moved four times, changed jobs three times, went from vegan to pescetarian to omnivore, went on and off different medications, and this cleanser had my back the entire time. Not saying it cured anything - retinol does the heavy lifting. But this cleanser has kept my skin balanced throughout the many ups and downs.

avis.titre: Came back to this after almost a decade
avis.texte: I used to love this about 10 years ago. But I didn't like that the toner has parabens (even tho I never used the toner) and I wanted a more economical and natural face regimen. So I stopped using this and switched to facial bar soap. I was able to get away with the bar soaps for a good while up until recently. I developed a severe reaction to all the "natural" products I'd been using and had to toss them (bad eczema all over my face kind of reaction). I went to ulta in search of skincare that would hopefully do the trick and remembered this guy. I used it for the first time all over again tonight and my itchiness is already gone. Hopefully, it does the trick longterm and I'll probably never stray again.

avis.titre: Love this but may be too much for those with sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love this - I love calendula smells, so I might be biased. At first, I believe my skin was compromised and inflamed when I first tried this and so it stung a lot like a chemical burn (it must be the citrus-based ingredients). But then over time, as my skin healed, it worked great. I bought the 7.8 fl oz bottle over a year ago, and I'm still working through it. My boyfriend also likes using this. I would recommend this for most people with normal skin types, but maybe not if you have extremely sensitive skin due to the acidic ingredients.

avis.titre: So sensitive for my acne prone skin!!!
avis.texte: I recently started acne medication and was in search of a face wash that wouldn't dry me out but left my skin feeling clean. That's when I stumbled upon this holy grail product! 20/10 recommend fr

I bought this because I have oily yet sensitive skin. At first I really liked this cleanser, but over time I found this cleanser to be extremely drying and causing breakouts, even though I have very oily skin. I stopped using it. The dryness and breakouts have stopped.

My skin was dry as all get out and red as can be. Met a Kiehls rep in ulta one day and she introduced me to this face wash and gave me a sample. I used it a few nights in a row and was sold! My skin was quickly gaining its moisture back and the redness was getting soothed. The key to the product is that a little goes a long way. Pump a pea sized amount and lather it together on your fingers then apply it to your face and wash your face. One bottle of this lasted me over a year, definitely worth the money to me. I follow it with the ultra repair moisturizer and my skin has never been better. I have very sensitive skin and this moisturizer has changed my life for the better. I recommend this to all my friends and turned them on to it. I will forever use this!!!!
Smells great but dried out my skin and I broke out after a few weeks. My husband tried it too and it dried out his skin. The big bottle we bought will be going to waste unfortunately.
Allergic to the rash wash. I was never allergic to any face wash till I started using this product. My face became really itchy after 2 uses. Now not sure what to do with my purchase.

avis.titre: Best sensitive skin wash I've ever found!
avis.texte: Thick, gentle formula that really leaves my face feeling clean without irritation or harsh exfoliation. It's a silky gel rather than a foaming liquid, which I love because it stays on the skin exactly the way it's applied, almost like a mask. I keep a bottle both in the shower and by the sink because now I won't clean my face with anything else.

avis.titre: It is a no for my skin
avis.texte: My friend had recommended me this face wash. My skin seemed to be a little bit dried every time I used it though I really like its smell and gel foam.

avis.titre: The best face wash use nothing else but this
avis.texte: I have been using for almost 20yrs face wash totally worth it.

This product offers a refreshing clean with a delightful scent that leaves me feeling invigorated. Its gentle formula effectively removes impurities without stripping the skin, leaving it soft and smooth. Perfect for daily use to maintain a fresh and radiant complexion.

Love the cleanser for my sensitive/acne prone skin. Its simple, lathers nicely, has a naturally pleasant smell (from the calendula flower and essential oils) and lasts a long time. Love that the pump locks for travel as well. The essential oils in this product might be irritating if you are going through intense treatments or exfoliation so watchnout for that but as a daily cleanser this is a wonderful option.
Really gentle facial cleanser. Only need a little amount to lather

avis.titre: Redness and irritation after each use
avis.texte: I generally love most of Kiehl's products - however, unfortunately this face wash was a disappointment. I had wanted a gentle cleansing wash (I normally use the Kiehl's Facial Fuel face wash as my daily cleanser during the day) for late evenings before bed - the Calendula Deep Cleansing wash caused redness directly after use that lasted for a short time, appearing to irritate my skin. This occurred after each and every use of the face wash I tried. My partner also tried it and had the same reaction, so we've discontinued use. Given the size of the bottle and price paid, it's unfortunate to have it go to waste.
I have been using this a long time- I like the pump bottle, great cleanser, pleasant smell.
This is my new daily face wash. Use it every night before bed, works fantastic in the shower.
Leaves my face clean and healthy. A part of my daily care routine for more than a year and likely to always be so.
I love the way this foaming wash feels and smells… you use very little for a non-drying gentle clean.

While the product promises that the face wash is 'non-drying foaming face cleanser' that replenishes and soothes skin - it made my skin very dry and there was breakouts too. I love all other products Kiehls has for dry skin ... however this is a huge let down and I am stuck with a huge bottle of it since I purchased it during one of the offers

avis.titre: Clean skin very well, affordable cleanser
avis.texte: I found this facial cleanser on a trip to Boston. I have sensitive skin that gets irritated easily, and this Kiehl's cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean without drying it out, and with no signs of irritation. I think it costs a lot for a small tube, but a little dab washes my entire face and neck. It's great quality so I will keep using it
Me and my fiancé got this recently and we love it so much. Such a great cleanser, smells great, and works on both of out two different types of skin.

This product offers a refreshing clean with a delightful scent that leaves me feeling invigorated. Its gentle formula effectively removes impurities without stripping the skin, leaving it soft and smooth. Perfect for daily use to maintain a fresh and radiant complexion.

I like using this as my second cleanser when I wear makeup or after my workouts. It smells so good and you feel so clean. I have been using Kiehl's for a couple years now and this is my go to cleanser. I can't go back to anything else. Kiehl's is the Best!

avis.titre: Pebbly skin after a few weeks
avis.texte: This face wash smells great and feels silky when using but is not quite enough or maybe right for my skin. After using for a few weeks, the texture of my face and neck began to be slightly pebbly and I broke out. Im pretty bummed as I enjoy the accompaning moisturizer so much. For me, it was a waste of money and very much regret buying the large size.

My skin is so clear and pretty again!! I have breakouts so often and my normal face wash just hasn't been cutting it- but after I started using this Calendula wash my acne has cleared up significantly! It feels refreshing and doesn't dry out my face
Received a sample and fell in love with how clean my face felt. Purchased a big bottle. Can see will last a long time. Little goes a long way.

I'm in mid 50s and have had acnes on my chin for a few years. I've been using different acne products for a few years. but it seems like nothing works. A few days ago I went to a trip and had a chance to use Calendula Deep Cleansing Forming Face Wash sample at night. Next morning,, I found out my chin acnes got almost 80% better and less flaking!!! So I ordered Calendula Deep Cleansing Forming Face Wash right away! Hope this product can help getting rid of acne!!! Fingers crossed!

avis.titre: Remove all my make up without overly stripping my skin
avis.texte: I love the effect of the skin cleaning agent. It is gentle and leaves my face feeling soft. I appreciate that it removes makeup easily and is a personal favorite for my skin type. Excellent quality!! Highly recommended!

I recently discovered the Kiehl's Calendula Deep Cleansing Foaming Face Wash and I'm loving it! This soap-free, sulfate-free cleanser is infused with Calendula, a natural healer known for its soothing and replenishing properties. It leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and balanced ❤️

avis.titre: My face feels clean and no eye irritation
avis.texte: I love this deep cleansing formula. Removes all makeup and doesn't irritate my skin nor eyes. It foams up nicely, a little goes a long way. My skin feels super clean but not stripped of oils. Highly recommend

I bought two bottles on sale. My friend recommended it to me. and it was a wonderful experience. The bottle is designed to be very easy to use, has a spout and you just need to press to get the amount you need to use. At first I thought such a bottle would be used up very quickly but no, just taking a small amount and creating a lot of foam is enough, very economical. It's a facial cleansing gel, the smell is not too strong, which is very suitable for me because I always prioritize skin care products with little scent (because I think it's natural). After using it, it leaves a layer of moisture on the face to help keep the skin from drying out (because my skin is combination and dry, I'm very satisfied). Well worth buying a bottle that you can use for a very, very long time, I'm stuck with it
Kiehl's has been one of my go to face washes for years! It never dries out my face and cleans all my makeup right off. It foams up really nicely, and leaves my face feeling refreshed.
I really liked this face wash. It makes my face feel so fresh.
I've only had this a couple of weeks now, but it's very cleansing. Not drying in my opinion, but you do not need a lot as it does foam!

Very disappointed, after using this product for years, I take advantage of buy 1 and get 1 off from the holidays, and clearly the product is not quality. Smells like cheap soap not do the job like it used to

This product is too harsh. I have used this product three times and it gave me redness, burn, irritation, and rush all over my face even on my eyelids every time I used it. Burn was so severe that my face hurt every time anything touched it... I've used calendula toner from Kiehls before and many other products from Kiehls but this was the first time this happened to my face.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: Love this product, a little bit goes a long way. Its ability to cleanse is the bonus coverage.
I've been wanting to try this. I guess it's not for my skin. I did receive a sample of the other face wash and love it!
Great product for daily use. The product is soft and does not dry skin.
Awesome company that cares and will help you if something is wrong right away!!! Outstanding products I have been using for years and see results of better skin. Just the best!!!

The face wash is amazing, no complaints. My criticism is with Kiehl's shipping. There has been at least a dozen mistakes in my received orders from wrong size, wrong item, to a missing item. If this happened once that wouldn't be an issue but this numerous orders over many years. I mean Kiehl's is great about sending out a replacement order forthwith but it's kind of strange how often this happens.

I started using this cleanser since 2018. Occasionally I got bored and tried different cleansers, but I always find myself come back to this. This is a gel cleanser. It can thoroughly clean my face without stripping my skin afterward. I have oily skin, so I'm not sure if this is too harsh for other skin types. At first, I thought this is a quite expensive cleanser, but a 250 ml bottle could last me at least 6 months (I use it twice daily), so it's very economic in my opinion. Safe to say that this is Top Of My Favorite Face Cleansers.
Best cleanser I've ever used. Third time I've purchased and plan to continue.
Love this cleanser. My face feels clean but never dry. I've tried so many cleansers, the Fresh Soy Cleanser, Cerave, Cetaphil, and even the other KIEHL'S cleanser. This one is hands down my favorite!
I love this face wash. It smells and feels amazing. Leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed.
Feels clean and washes off nicely. Does not leave any residue.
I have sensitive acne prone skin. This cleanser was recommended to my by my esthetician. It's gentle on my skin yet takes off makeup. I absolutely love it!
This product makes my face feel so clean. It feels so luxurious and non drying, yet would clean an oily type of skin well also. I love this product most of all.
Too harsh. Calendula is meant to be soothing, but this gives me a rashy redness around the eyes everytime i use it. I threw it out. Kiehl's uses tons of harsh chemicals.
I have used this for more than a year, and it has now become my face wash of choice.

avis.titre: Worth to buy; neutral; no irritation
avis.texte: It removes most of dirts from the skin. Calendula-smell scent which makes skin feel calming. Very good size that can last up to 2 months. Calendula ingredient is essential for skin.

avis.titre: CALENDULA  is a gift from the Gods.
avis.texte: The deep cleansing effect Allow me to remain fresh in my active lifestyle. We use this product on daily basis to maintain the natural glow God bless us with

I ordered a large and travel size of this product. I am very satisfied with the face wash, it leaves my face feeling clean and does not leave any residue. I rated 4 stars instead of 5 because the top of the travel size container was cracked.

This is the best and only facial cleanser that me and my daughter uses. It does what they says it does and last a long time. A little bit goes a long way. I absolutely love it. I get compliments on my skin all the time and I am 57yrs young.
Gentle and effective wash that gives a good clean feeling to my skin every time! Just what I was searching for in a face wash. Thank you, Kiehl's!
Good everyday cleanser that I've used for years - would recommend

I received a sample of this product, as part of a sample giveaway at Nordstroms. I gave it a try and liked it. I have normal skin. After using an eye makeup remover, I take a little bit and combine it with some water. I gently massage it on my face, as it removes my make up. I rinse thoroughly and moisturize. This is my second order of this product and I am very happy with it.
Foams easily in hands and is gentle. My daughter uses it also. I recommend it.
Love this face wash, not heavy, lathers nicely, and leaves skin feeling refreshed and clean!
Excellent. I will only use this cleanser. Hands down the Best!
This is the best cleanser I've ever used! It leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean. This cleanser has no odor, and is not drying to my skin.
The facewash itself is great, unfortunately the travel size bottle leaks whenever it is not standing up, so your travel bag becomes a soap-slimey mess.

avis.titre: This face wash is a keeper!
avis.texte: I have been using this in thr morning and night, before I use the Midnight Recovery Botanical Cleansing Oil, and I really like it. My skin is not dry and feels clean and soft. I have tried so many face washes and soaps but this one seems to be the best I have tried so far. I se the Cleansing Oil and Midnight Oil Recovery Omega Rich Botanical Night Cream also. All of them smell so nice. Calming. I highly recommend this face wash.
Wonderful product. My skin feels incredibly clean but not stripped. The wash also smells amazing!
LOVE LOVE LOVE ❤️ this cleanser. Use this in the morning while in the shower. Create some suds between the palms then cleanse the nooks and crannies of the face. Fresh citrus scent and refreshing!
This is the best facial cleanser I've used. It doesn't dry skin out but doesn't make it feel oily either. Perfect balance.

avis.titre: Product is good, but nozzle head quality very bad
avis.texte: product is good, but nozzle head pretty bad, I have to clicked more than 10 time to get a little liquid soap.
I bought this wash on 11/19 and on 11-28 you are charging me for 16.9 oz more.

It's probably one of my favorite cleansers. It cleanse my skin but does not make my skin dry. However, the pump is SO tight. It slipped away from my wet hand many times. I have to tilt the bottle when pumping otherwise the gel drip on the neck and the bottle. The pump is the only reason stopping me from purchasing.

I got a free sample with the promos and was excited to try this. Application was nice and foam felt like it was cleansing my skin. However after 2nd use it started dry up my skin. By the 3rd day I had scaly and started to break out. Not recommended for sensitive skin.
It's not non-comedogenic. The website did not make that clear at all.
I use the cleaner with its toner. Both are amazing because they actually clean as it's claimed and never dry my skin. I've been using the cleaner for year. I highly recommend this product.

I have been using this cleanser for years and it continues to keep my skin looking clear. I love the smell and it does a great job at removing makeup! It's a little expensive but i can usually get the big bottle to last me an entire year. Highly recommend!!
You can feel clean skin after washing your face, but it will dry your face so bad. I have combination skin and usually i dont feel any dryness, but with this product you will defiantly feel dry skin.

I have been using this for about 2 years and my skin is clear and soft! I have trouble area under my chin due to menopause breakouts and since I've been using this that area looks 1000% better and the trouble spots have faded. I tried other products that were cheaper but they did not work. I stick with this and it works wonders!
Tried the sample this morning, and it was amazing, look now for best size and price.
Love this toner, I actually need to order the bigger size but wanted to try it out first. It's a keeper in my routine, clearing my dark spots leaving my skin very soft and supple!
Your cleanser really does a great job of cleaning deeply without stripping. Definitely a quality face wash and a little goes a long way!

avis.titre: Amazing for my acne prone skin
avis.texte: I tried this cleanser on a whim when traveling with someone who had it and it left my skin feeling deeply cleansed and fresh. I'm very picky with cleansers as I have very sensitive skin. I swear my skin has been so much clearer within a few weeks of using this cleanser. I think the main reason is because it really takes off all of your makeup without drying the skin. This is a new staple in my skincare routine!
I really like this moisturizer. It does leave your skin feeling clean and hydrated. It helps that it also smells good.
Great scent, ease of use feels great on my skin and last long if used correctly I've been using this product for about a month and a half now and have more than enough to last the year
I'm Asian, when i was in my country, my skin was oily, but when i came to Us, my skin was changed dryness. This product still good with me! Gentle with me 😘

Im having hard time finding facial wash for my sensitive oily skin when i started using this everything had been changed. Ive been 10yrs user of this product and i will highly recommend this with everyone who got same problem as mine.

avis.titre: it is a reliable choice for clean and balanced skin.
avis.texte: The Calendula Deep Cleansing Foaming Face Wash is a soothing and effective cleanser. It removes dirt and impurities without drying out the skin. The formula is gentle and suitable for all skin types. It helps minimize pores and leaves the skin feeling refreshed. The packaging and price could be improved, but overall, it is a reliable choice for clean and balanced skin.
My face feels refreshed after using this facial cleanser. This doesn't dry my skin. I love it.
Light and foamy! Subtle fragrance. Non-stripping! Fav cleanser!
I use this every night for my bedtime routine. My face looks and feels great after using this product.

I first used Kiehl's Calendula Deep Cleansing Foaming Face Wash when my skin got heavy breakouts, and my friend recommended this to me. It was my skin savior because it was very gentle on my sensitive skin back then, helped cleanse it, nurture it, not causing any further damage at the same time. That why I have been using it since then, even now when my skin gets much better. Overall, it is a good product for your skin with very light scent. I have been recommending this to so many friends and families.

I have used this face wash for a month. It gently clean and nourish my face. The ingredient contains glycerin that help the moisture barrier for softer-feeling skin. However, i feel like my skin not clean enough after being washed, skin is sticky and feel like a little bit oily. Also, the scent is like glue. For me, fragrance free is better than that kind of scent.
This face wash is long-lasting and perfect for my skin. Strong enough to really clean but gentle enough not to dry me out.

I discovered this cleanser in 2019 and I remembered that this cleanser basically changed my skin although it was not perfect or near perfect but the difference was huge. But I think when 2020/2021 came I suddenly wanted to try new cleansers, new skincare etc. so again, my skin got messy and I was back to 0. I purchased a new bottle earlier this year but I used the cleanser for a few weeks only bc again, tried new skincare because I have to tackle a lot of problems and not only acne. Now, I might have hormonal acne and it explains why no matter my skincare it wasn't helping my acne and I was so frustrated. Almost a week ago, I saw my calendula cleanser just lying around my bathroom and it got me thinking, should I go back to this cleanser? It might help my acne even just a little bit so I'm now using it again and Just like how much I loved this product back in 2019, now I got the same reaction from myself because it made so much difference (texture, acne etc). Except for my jawline acne I mean it's helping with the redness but I'm not expecting much bc again, I might have hormonal and I still have to visit the doctor but for my cheeks, forehead acne it's almost gone and i've been using it for almost a week so now I'll have to accept that this cleanser is probably it for me. I have oily, acne-prone/sensitive skin so it's really hard for me to find products that suit me so. I'll just stick to this cleanser because it's really the cleanser for my skin so I hope kiehl's will NEVER

avis.titre: Does the job keeping your pores  clean!
avis.texte: I love this cleanser! My pores are clean and my skin is happy!
Ive been usingvit for about a weak and really like how it works on my skin. I have ulta-sensitive skin. This definitely deep cleans.

avis.titre: As Good As Advertised -If Not Better
avis.texte: Initially I wasn't too happy with this cleanser because Kiehl's made me switch from the Oil Eliminator as it was discontinued. To me the Oil Eliminator delivered. Now,…after making the switch for about 2-3 months, and using it daily, I can honestly say I prefer the Calendula Deep Cleanser because it works better AND keeps my skin clean, clear, and shine free. It also minimizes open pores dramatically, more so than the Oil Eliminator I was using. All in all the Calendula Deep Cleanser delivers and works perhaps better than advertised.

I read some reviews regarding this product and how it was good for oily skin. I am more than satisfied with this product. I was particularly attracted to the fact that it would remove all make up as well from my face. I have very oily and acne prone skin, even as a mature woman. This is a fantastic product. I would highly recommend it.

I don't think I've ever been as pleased with any cleanser I've ever tried as I have been with this one. My skin really does feel fresh after using it, and I haven't found it drying at all, which surprised me because my skin does tend to be dry outside the t-zone. But I actually find this cleanser more gentle and soothing than the Kiehl's cucumber one for dry skin, and I am thinking of switching but will have to see if this one doesn't suit my skin in colder weather. I am really hoping that's not the case, though, because I really never have liked a cleanser this much before.
After using this calendula cleanser you face feels clean, not dry out, refreshingly clean.
Great cleanser, not harsh at all and leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed

I've gone through several bottles of this wash and I love it, but the pump broke within 2-3 uses on my most recent bottle. I contacted Kiehl's asking if I could just get a new pump piece and received a standard form response with return instructions. It seems silly and wasteful to pay for return shipping when I like the face wash, I just needed a new pump or disc top cap.

This is the best cleanser I've ever used! I've been using since I was in my 20s, now in my 40s and it's still the only cleanser that takes off all my makeup (including eye makeup), leaves me feeling clean yet not dried out.
I have been using this product for years. Great for sensitive skin. Great for daily use.

avis.titre: Good Product not for younger skin
avis.texte: Bought this for my daughter who is in her teens. This product ended up drying her skin out so fast. I ended up moving her to a more gentle brand. The product is a gel like formula. Little to no scent. Can be more drying than most so if you feel that this likely is not the product for you skin should feel supple after washing not squeaky clean, if it is that means the product has stripped your natural oils from the face. Not great.

avis.titre: Kiehl's Calendula Deep Cleansing Face Wash
avis.texte: My wife was suffering allergies from several well-known and sometimes quite expensive face washes over the years. These allergies were often worse with some "hypo-allergenic" and "natural" face washes. She tried Kiehl's at her sister's home and was instantly amazed at the "clean feeling" without a reaction. Amazing product.

This is my favorite face wash of all time, especially to get rid of all the gunk after a long day. It really gets everything off and feels very gentle. The smell is also pleasant and overpowering. I will probably use this forever!!
I just love this face wash! It smells great and has a nice foam. It also does a beautiful job cleansing and calming my skin. It's more than a wash, it's a skin treatment!

When it comes to cosmetics, I don't have knowledge and my face is worse with acne all over with a scar for several years. I monitor my face after using this and acne and oily being washed away, as review suggests without stripping off moisture. Sometimes, I can feel burning because I have high sensitivity but, there is still no problem to it.
I use Calendula Deep Cleaning twice a day. I live in the desert where it is dusty I'm outside all day for work so making sure my skin is clean without dying it out is important.

avis.titre: Best product for acne and oily skin
avis.texte: Love it ! I have super oily skin and very bad acne .. I always heard people telling me to use it and never had a chance to try it until my friend got me some samples !! It helps very much .. my acne got improved and my skin seems brighter with less redness , I'm have tried thousands of brand for many many years and Kiehl's really help …
I really enjoyed using this face wash. It has a very mild scent to it and is gentle, yet effective. It wasn't drying at all.and did a great job cleansing the skin.

avis.titre: Cause irritation, swelling, scaly skin, burning,
avis.texte: The Calendula Deep Cleansing Foaming Face Wash caused my eyelid irritation, swelling, Scaly skin, burning, pain, and rash week. My face and neck had scaly skin and irritation. It is horrible, and I am continuing to use the Cortisone on my eyelid, cheeks, and neck.

Only kiehls product that has dissapointed me. When my skin is oily it stripped my face and felt dry and cool. Tight but bareable and in season/ occasion when my skin was dry and compromised it enhanced the dryness and felt tight and uncomfortable. Not a huge fan of the calendula toner either..
